tonight.headline: Likely kicks off tonight; Boston's DNP is now on the official report
body: Bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten's Wednesday DNP (ankle/foot) is confirmed on CBS's league-wide report, and Denzel Boston — Garrett Wilson's first fallback — is a DNP with a toe on the official Browns report (houstontexans.com, 11 Nov). Wilson himself was limited and is still in the protocol (Jets report, 11 Nov). Minnesota have still not named Jefferson's quarterback.

ESPN: 132.6 to 120.2, 56%. The lineup as set is the projection lineup — nothing to change today. Isaiah Likely plays tonight at 19:15 CDMX with J.J. McCarthy cleared; Diggs, on the bench, locks with him. The two checks stay on Sunday 10:30 CDMX: Tuten (if out, Warren to RB and Metcalf at FLEX) and Wilson (if out, Boston — Metcalf if Boston is out too).

case.label: Their side
case.body: Nicky Jam still had Colston Loveland in their TE slot on a Chicago bye at 12:50Z, with Hunter Henry on the bench — a fix one tap away for them, so do not count on the zero.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten and Wilson both inactive with Boston also out: Metcalf takes one slot and Allgeier the other, and the 56% falls.

whatWentWrong.title: Wilson's first fallback is now his second
whatWentWrong.lead: Boston was a DNP on Wednesday's official Browns report with a toe; Metcalf is the realistic cover.

case.label: What changed
case.body: Yesterday's 16:00 brief had Boston 'not expected to practise' from a CBS item; the official Texans-Browns report (houstontexans.com, 11 Nov 16:33) now lists him DNP (toe). The contingency order stands — Boston if active, Metcalf if not — but Boston playing now needs two practices in a row.

case.label: Why Metcalf is fine
case.body: Metcalf plays Sunday night, so he is still movable at 10:30 CDMX for either Tuten or Wilson. He is not on the Steelers' Wednesday report (steelers.com 11 Nov).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Boston full on Friday — then he is the cover again at 12.8 against Metcalf's 11.2.
